channels.name: Artificial Intelligence
channels.tagline: Machine intelligence turned toward medicine, materials, energy, and discovery.

items.title: AI model designs enzymes that break down PET plastic at room temperature
items.summary: A generative protein model proposed candidate enzymes; three degraded common bottle plastic in hours during lab tests.

items.title: Machine learning speeds hunt for room-temperature superconductors
items.summary: A model trained on known crystal structures ranked thousands of untested compounds, narrowing the search.

items.title: Diagnostic AI matches specialists on rare childhood diseases in India trial
items.summary: A tool developed with hospitals in Bengaluru flagged uncommon genetic conditions from routine records.

items.title: Chinese lab releases open weather model rivaling numerical forecasts
items.summary: The system produces ten-day forecasts in seconds on a single GPU, with strong monsoon-region results.

items.title: Latin America unites on ethical AI roadmap
items.summary: A regional AI plan agreed by 20 countries includes a new expert group to combat disinformation.

items.title: Indian researchers use AI to map groundwater depletion
items.summary: A machine learning model trained on satellite data tracks aquifer decline across northern India.

channels.name: Advanced Materials
channels.tagline: New molecules, metals, and polymers for cleaner energy, water, and air.

items.title: Porous crystal captures CO2 directly from flue gas at low temperature
items.summary: A metal-organic framework grabs carbon dioxide selectively and releases it with gentle heating.

items.title: Self-healing polymer extends the life of wind-turbine blades
items.summary: Microscopic capsules release a resin that seals cracks as they form, reducing offshore maintenance.

items.title: Biodegradable plastic made from sugarcane waste passes durability tests
items.summary: A Brazilian team turned cane residue into a sturdy film that composts within months.

items.title: New alloy stays strong at temperatures that melt ordinary steel
items.summary: The material could enable more efficient jet engines and industrial furnaces.

channels.name: Synthetic Biology
channels.tagline: Engineered organisms and programmed DNA — cells built for computing, data storage, and chemical synthesis.

items.title: Did scientists just create synthetic life?
items.summary: The SpudCell certainly resembles a living cell, but a key structure inside the cell falls short of the real thing.

items.title: Living cells store and retrieve data using DNA-based logic circuits
items.summary: Engineered genetic circuits record signals over time, letting a colony of cells act as a rewritable biological memory.

items.title: Engineered yeast becomes a microbial factory for industrial solvents
items.summary: Metabolic engineering reprogrammed the yeast's pathways to secrete a chemical normally made from petroleum.

items.title: Synthetic cell with a minimal genome divides on its own
items.summary: Researchers pared a bacterium down to a designed, minimal set of genes, then coaxed it to grow and split normally.

channels.name: Energy & Water
channels.tagline: Science and technology for sustainable energy and clean, fresh water for more of humanity.

items.title: Sponge-like material pulls drinking water from desert air overnight
items.summary: A low-cost hydrogel absorbs moisture in dry conditions and releases it with mild sunlight.

items.title: New membrane cuts the energy cost of seawater desalination by a third
items.summary: An ultrathin filter lets water through while blocking salt, lowering the power a plant needs.

items.title: Perovskite-silicon solar cell reaches record efficiency in outdoor test
items.summary: The tandem design converted more sunlight to power than either layer alone, holding up over months.

items.title: Low-cost filter removes arsenic from village wells in Bangladesh
items.summary: A simple iron-based cartridge brought contaminated water within safe limits in field trials.

channels.name: Space Exploration
channels.tagline: New missions, spacecraft, and technologies for reaching and developing the space environment.

items.title: India's lunar rover confirms subsurface ice near the south pole
items.summary: Instruments detected buried water ice, a resource that could support future crewed landings.

items.title: Reusable heavy-lift rocket completes its first orbital flight
items.summary: The vehicle delivered its payload and returned both stages intact, a milestone toward cheaper orbit access.

items.title: Europe's Mars sample-return mission passes critical design review
items.summary: Engineers cleared the spacecraft that will retrieve rock cores and bring them to Earth.

items.title: Compact ion engine promises faster trips to the outer planets
items.summary: The thruster ran continuously for months in a vacuum chamber, hinting at efficient deep-space travel.

channels.name: Astronomy & Astrophysics
channels.tagline: New telescopes, satellites, and discoveries across the cosmos.

items.title: Webb telescope spots water vapor in a rocky planet's atmosphere
items.summary: Spectra reveal signs of water around a small exoplanet, sharpening the search for habitable worlds.

items.title: New radio array in the southern hemisphere maps the early universe
items.summary: First light captured faint hydrogen signals from billions of years ago, revealing early galaxies.

items.title: Astronomers trace a fast radio burst to a magnetar in a nearby galaxy
items.summary: Precise localization tied one of these millisecond flashes to a highly magnetized neutron star.

items.title: Survey finds hundreds of new gravitational lenses with machine help
items.summary: The lenses act as natural telescopes, magnifying distant galaxies for closer study.
